column2: /adk-system-designer I need a proof of concept of an ADK agent that answers questions about our HR policy PDFs (about 30 documents). Just me, about 6 hours spread over two days; the demo to HR leadership is on Friday. Design and plan it, then write ticket files for the phase 1 goals. Do not implement.

/adk-system-designer Design an internal ADK assistant for our 25-person IT helpdesk that searches our Confluence runbooks and creates Jira tickets on request. Two senior engineers who have already shipped several ADK agents on GCP, about half their time for two weeks. Design and plan it, then write ticket files for the phase 1 goals. Do not implement.

/adk-system-designer Design an internal ADK assistant for our 25-person IT helpdesk that searches our Confluence runbooks and creates Jira tickets on request. Two engineers who are new to ADK and have never used GCP, about half their time for two weeks. Design and plan it, then write ticket files for the phase 1 goals. Do not implement.

/adk-system-designer We're three developers at a startup. We want to ship an MVP of an ADK booking assistant for a chain of five hair salons that books, moves and cancels appointments through our existing booking API, within two weeks, then keep improving it. Design and plan it, then write ticket files for the phase 1 goals and say who could take which. Design only.

/adk-system-designer Design a production ADK agent for an insurance company that helps customers file a home-insurance claim with photos and creates the claim in our Guidewire system. Five engineers, one ML engineer and a part-time security reviewer, five months to general availability in the EU. Design and plan it, then write ticket files for the phase 1 goals. Do not implement.
/adk-engineer Please take ticket tickets/T-202.md and carry it out. Tell me which specialist you are using and why.
